summary: UTLVAL00 is a batch Data Validation Utility. It reads a validation-control file and, for each control record, dispatches on the validation type (INTEGRITY / XREF / FORMAT / BALANCE), running the corresponding checks against the position master and transaction history files and writing any problems to an error report. It is meant to perform data-integrity, cross-reference, format and balance-reconciliation validation across the portfolio data. NOTE: like TSTVAL00, the low-level check sub-paragraphs (2210/2220/2310/2320/2410/2420/2510/2520) are referenced but NOT defined in the source — the dispatch skeleton exists but the actual validations are unimplemented.

paragraphs.name: 1100-OPEN-FILES
paragraphs.pseudocode:
OPEN INPUT VALIDATION-CONTROL; IF status<>'00' -> error handler
OPEN INPUT POSITION-MASTER; IF status<>'00' -> error handler
OPEN INPUT TRANSACTION-HISTORY; IF status<>'00' -> error handler
OPEN OUTPUT ERROR-REPORT; IF status<>'00' -> error handler

paragraphs.name: 2000-PROCESS
paragraphs.pseudocode:
WHILE NOT end of validation DO
  READ VALIDATION-CONTROL
  IF at end THEN SET END-OF-VALIDATION ELSE CALL 2100-PROCESS-VALIDATION
END WHILE
branches: READ ... AT END / NOT AT END

paragraphs.name: 2100-PROCESS-VALIDATION
paragraphs.pseudocode:
SELECT CASE validation type
  WHEN 'INTEGRITY': CALL 2200-CHECK-INTEGRITY
  WHEN 'XREF':      CALL 2300-CHECK-XREF
  WHEN 'FORMAT':    CALL 2400-CHECK-FORMAT
  WHEN 'BALANCE':   CALL 2500-CHECK-BALANCE
  ELSE: SET 'INVALID VALIDATION TYPE'; CALL 9999-ERROR-HANDLER
END SELECT

annotations.note: SME REVIEW: 2210/2220 are undefined stubs — integrity checks not implemented.
SME REVIEW: 2310/2320 undefined — cross-reference checks not implemented.
SME REVIEW: 2410/2420 undefined — format checks not implemented.
SME REVIEW: 2510/2520 undefined — balance reconciliation not implemented.

paragraphs.name: 9999-ERROR-HANDLER
paragraphs.pseudocode:
INCREMENT WS-RECORDS-ERROR
SET ERROR-FOUND = true
SET WS-ERR-DESC = WS-ERROR-MESSAGE
WRITE the error line to ERROR-REPORT

annotations.note: Unlike TSTVAL00's handler, this one records the error and continues (does not GOBACK).
